description: Make one connected Google account the default. With several accounts connected, every Gmail and Workspace verb called without an `account` argument runs as the default and names it in the result. account accepts the email or alias from list_accounts.
embedding_description: Choose which linked Google account (for example work or home) the assistant uses by default when a mail, Drive or Docs request does not name an account. Takes the email address or alias of an already connected account and returns the new default.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the new default account by email and alias.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Change the default connected Google account.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.unknown_account: no connected account matches; the message lists the connected accounts. gsuite.invalid_params: account missing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Pick an email or alias from the listed accounts, or run connect_account to add the account first.
